name: app-modernizer
description: GitHub Copilot Extension for converting legacy SOAP and REST APIs to modern OpenAPI specs, GraphQL schemas, and ROA-standard APIs

chatParticipants.name: appmod
chatParticipants.description: Convert legacy SOAP and REST APIs to modern OpenAPI specs or GraphQL schemas

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Analyze workspace endpoints to detect SOAP and REST APIs

commands.name: generate-openapi
commands.description: Generate Backend API OpenAPI spec from analyzed endpoints (ROA standard)

commands.name: generate-openapi-xapi
commands.description: Generate Experience Layer (xAPI) OpenAPI spec with session handling and consumer headers

commands.name: generate-graphql
commands.description: Generate GraphQL schema from analyzed endpoints

commands.name: generate-code
commands.description: Generate code implementation using OpenAPI Generator

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Run the full conversion pipeline for a specific API (provide API name)

appmod.roaStandards.description: Company-specific ROA (Resource Oriented Architecture) standards configuration

appmod.preferredModel.description: Preferred Copilot model for analysis tasks

appmod.sourceFolder.description: Source workspace folder containing legacy APIs

appmod.targetFolder.description: Target workspace folder for generated output
